thresholds.note: geom_tau = median over correct frames of |det_c - pred_c| / gate_radius; app_tau = median over correct frames of the appearance cost of the selected candidate. The |log h| leg is the plan's fixed 0.25, and the correct-frame median is reported only to show it sits inside that bound.

acceptance_rule.source: docs/E077_PLAN.md (ship rule written before the run; not edited)
acceptance_rule.text: SHIP only if pooled TSR rises by >= +3 pp with the 95 % CI of the paired delta excluding 0, and the upper bound of the paired dFAR CI is < +3 pp, and the blind-AND-present share falls. KILL if bit-identical (inert) or TSR falls.
